info.name: Vic.ai Accounts Invoice Approval Flows API

items.docs:
Lists invoice approval flows for a company. Returns a paginated list of
approval flows with their selection rules and steps.

## Creating a Flow with Selection Rules

When you create an approval flow (see the main invoice approval flow endpoint documentation for the request/response contract), you can define the selection rules that determine which invoices will be routed through that flow and its steps. The sections below describe the structure and semantics for those selection rules so you can include them in the `InvoiceApprovalFlowInputV2` payload.

**Request Body:** `InvoiceApprovalFlowInputV2`

**Response:** `201

params.name: id
params.description:
The ID of the invoice approval flow. Can be either:
- An integer ID (the internal database ID)
- A `remote_id` (a string identifier used to look up the flow)

If the value is a valid integer, the system will first attempt to find the flow by its integer ID.
If not found or if the value is not a valid integer, it will attempt to find the flow by `remote_id`.

items.docs:
Updates an existing approval flow with selection rules and steps.
The flow must belong to the company associated with the OAuth client.

The request body structure and selection rules are the same as the POST endpoint
for creating an approval flow. See the POST endpoint documentation for complete
details on flow structure, selection rules, steps, and approver selection rules.
